verifiedScope.proxy: Selected fantasy-novel first-book-publication window, from Jim Button and Luke the Engine Driver to The Night of Wishes, used as a publishing proxy rather than a full-career span or a claim of uninterrupted writing. The five markers use original German book years, not composition, serialization, later editions, translations or adaptations; English titles are supplied for readability. Momo uses its documented 1973 original edition. The Neverending Story appeared in German in 1979; the cited English Doubleday edition followed in 1983. Picture books, shorter fiction, collections, plays, poetry, nonfiction and posthumous releases are outside this selection, so later books do not extend this scoped bar.
